verdict.rationale: A SaaS data-movement platform could plausibly ship an official CLI, so this axis applies. The evidence shows a REST API, a Python Connector SDK, an official MCP server, and plugins that add Connector SDK skills to third-party agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI). None of these items documents a Fivetran-branded command-line tool, and the agent CLIs named are third-party products.
